# ScriptServerEntity

*Server*

An entity on the server, e.g. the subject of an event: position, rotation, movement, health, states and forms. Players and NPCs are subclasses with more methods.

## Methods

### getMinecraftEntity {#getminecraftentity}

::: member

**Returns** `T` — the Minecraft entity this wrapper controls, for Java code; scripts rarely need it

:::

### setPosition {#setposition}

::: member

Teleports the entity to a world position. Living entities are teleported, so clients see a jump instead of a movement.

```js
c.getPlayer().setPosition(485, 43, 43);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x in blocks |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y in blocks |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z in blocks |

:::

### getPosition {#getposition}

::: member

```js
var pos = c.getPlayer().getPosition();

c.getPlayer().setPosition(pos.x, pos.y + 10, pos.z);
```

**Returns** [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) — new vector with the position of the entity's feet, in blocks

:::

### setRotation {#setrotation}

::: member

Turns the entity at once. Players are turned by their client; only living entities can be turned.

```js
c.getPlayer().setRotation(0, 90, 90);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pitch` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | vertical angle in degrees, -90 (up) to 90 (down) |
| `yaw` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | horizontal angle of the body in degrees |
| `headYaw` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | horizontal angle of the head in degrees; players turn the head with the yaw instead |

:::

### setRotation {#setrotation-2}

::: member

Turns the entity at once, also its body, see [`setRotation(float, float, float)`](#setrotation).

```js
c.getPlayer().setRotation(0, 90, 90, 90);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pitch` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | vertical angle in degrees, -90 (up) to 90 (down) |
| `yaw` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | horizontal angle in degrees |
| `headYaw` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | horizontal angle of the head in degrees |
| `bodyYaw` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | horizontal angle of the body in degrees |

:::

### getRotation {#getrotation}

::: member

```js
var rotation = c.getPlayer().getRotation();

c.send("Pitch " + rotation.x + ", yaw " + rotation.y);
```

**Returns** [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) — new vector of the angles in degrees: x is the pitch, y the yaw and z the head yaw

:::

### getBodyYaw {#getbodyyaw}

::: member

**Returns** [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) — horizontal angle of the body in degrees; it can differ from the head yaw

:::

### setSpeed {#setspeed}

::: member

Changes the movement speed of a living entity until [`resetSpeed()`](#resetspeed): the speed attribute is multiplied by

`1 + speed`. Removes all other speed modifiers, e.g. of sprinting and potions, until they are applied again.

```js
c.getPlayer().setSpeed(1); // twice as fast
c.getPlayer().setSpeed(-0.5); // half speed
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `speed` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | added part of the normal speed: 0 is normal, 1 twice as fast, -1 stops walking |

:::

### resetSpeed {#resetspeed}

::: member

Removes all modifiers of the movement speed of a living entity, also the one of [`setSpeed(float)`](#setspeed).

:::

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the entity sprints

### createDisplayForm {#createdisplayform}

::: member

Creates a display form attached to this entity with a random UUID as its ID. The position is an offset from the entity's feet. The display is not shown until [`show()`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm#show) is called.

```js
var form = scram.form('{"id":"bbs:mob","mobId":"minecraft:pig"}');

c.getPlayer().createDisplayForm(form).setPosition(0, 2.5, 0).setThroughWalls(true).show();
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `form` | [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) | form to display, not null; copied |

**Returns** [`ScriptServerDisplayForm`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm) — display shown to every player once shown, without a lifetime limit

:::

### createDisplayForm {#createdisplayform-2}

::: member

Creates a display form attached to this entity, see [`createDisplayForm(BBSForm)`](#createdisplayform). Showing it replaces a shown display with the same ID, which can be found later with `c.getServer().getDisplayForm(id)`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | display ID, not empty |
| `form` | [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) | form to display, not null; copied |

**Returns** [`ScriptServerDisplayForm`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm) — display that is not shown yet

:::

### createSound {#createsound}

::: member

Creates a sound that follows this entity, with a random UUID as its ID; it plays once

[`play()`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound#play) is called.


**Returns** [`ScramServerSound`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound) — sound at the entity's feet that does not play yet

:::

### rayTraceBlock {#raytraceblock}

::: member

Traces a ray from the entity's eyes in the look direction to the first block.

```js
function main(c) {
    const player = c.getPlayer();
    const rayTrace = player.rayTraceBlock(10, false);

    if (rayTrace.isBlock()) {
        c.send("Looking at the " + rayTrace.getBlockSide() + " side");
    }
}
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `maxDistance` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | length of the ray in blocks |
| `includesFluids` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether water and lava stop the ray |

**Returns** [`ScriptServerRayTrace`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerRayTrace) — result: the hit block, or a miss at the end of the ray

:::

### rayTraceEntity {#raytraceentity}

::: member

Traces a ray from the entity's eyes in the look direction to the first entity; blocks do not stop it.

```js
function main(c) {
    const rayTrace = c.getPlayer().rayTraceEntity(10);

    if (rayTrace.isEntity()) {
        rayTrace.getEntity().setVelocity(0, 1, 0);
    }
}
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `maxDistance` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | length of the ray in blocks |

**Returns** [`ScriptServerRayTrace`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerRayTrace) — result: the hit entity, or a miss if no entity is on the ray

:::

### getLook {#getlook}

::: member

```js
function main(c) {
    const player = c.getPlayer();
    const look = player.getLook();

    player.setVelocity(look.x, look.y, look.z);
}
```

**Returns** [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) — new vector of the direction the head looks; about one block long

:::

### moveTo {#moveto}

::: member

Smoothly moves the entity to a world position over `durationTicks` ticks, ignoring its own movement and gravity on the way; it does not take fall damage from the path. Players are moved by their client, which keeps the motion smooth: the path starts when the client receives it, the player cannot walk away during it, and the server corrects paths through solid blocks and faster than about 10 blocks per tick back. Other entities are placed every tick without teleporting, so clients interpolate them.

```js
c.getPlayer().moveTo("sine_inout", 40, 0, 100, 0);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `interpolation` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | BBS interpolation name, e.g. `"linear"`; unknown names are linear |
| `durationTicks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | duration in ticks; 0 or less teleports immediately |
| `x` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | target x |
| `y` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | target y |
| `z` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | target z |

:::

### moveRelatively {#moverelatively}

::: member

Smoothly moves the entity by the given number of blocks along each axis over `durationTicks` ticks. Only axes with a non-zero offset follow the path: along the others the entity keeps moving on its own, so for example `moveRelatively("linear", 20, 0, 5, 0)` lifts a player by 5 blocks while they can still walk. Gravity and fall damage are suspended only when the y axis is driven. Smoothness, delay and server checks are the same as in [`moveTo(String, int, float, float, float)`](#moveto).

```js
c.getPlayer().moveRelatively("sine_out", 20, 0, 5, 0);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `interpolation` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | BBS interpolation name, e.g. `"linear"`; unknown names are linear |
| `durationTicks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | duration in ticks; 0 or less moves immediately |
| `x` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | blocks to move along x; 0 leaves the axis free |
| `y` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | blocks to move along y; 0 leaves the axis free |
| `z` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | blocks to move along z; 0 leaves the axis free |

:::

### rotateTo {#rotateto}

::: member

Smoothly turns the entity to the given angles over `durationTicks` ticks. For players the rotation runs on their client every frame, like the client camera's rotateTo: the player keeps moving (also mid-jump), cannot turn the camera with the mouse until the rotation ends, and the head follows the yaw, so `headYaw` is ignored. Other entities are rotated once per tick.

```js
c.getPlayer().rotateTo("sine_inout", 20, 0, 90, 90);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `interpolation` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | BBS interpolation name, e.g. `"linear"`; unknown names are linear |
| `durationTicks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | duration in ticks; 0 or less rotates immediately |
| `pitch` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | target pitch in degrees |
| `yaw` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | target yaw in degrees |
| `headYaw` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | target head yaw in degrees; ignored for players |

:::

### lockPosition {#lockposition}

::: member

Teleports a living entity, then locks its position, see [`lockPosition()`](#lockposition).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | x in blocks |
| `y` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | y in blocks |

:::

### lockRotation {#lockrotation-2}

::: member

Locks the rotation of a living entity: a player cannot turn the camera with the mouse. Scripts can still turn it. The lock is saved with the entity and stays until [`unlockRotation()`](#unlockrotation).

:::

### lockPosition {#lockposition-2}

::: member

Locks the position of a living entity: it does not move on its own (walking, falling, pushes), but teleports still work. The lock is saved with the entity and stays until [`unlockPosition()`](#unlockposition).

:::

### unlockRotation {#unlockrotation}

::: member

Lets a living entity turn again after [`lockRotation()`](#lockrotation).

:::

### unlockPosition {#unlockposition}

::: member

Lets a living entity move again after [`lockPosition()`](#lockposition).

:::

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the rotation of a living entity is locked by [`lockRotation()`](#lockrotation)

:::

### isPositionLocked {#ispositionlocked}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the position of a living entity is locked by [`lockPosition()`](#lockposition)

:::

### setArmor {#setarmor}

::: member

Replaces the whole armor set with copies of the stacks; null takes a piece off.

```js
c.getPlayer().setArmor(scram.item("minecraft:iron_helmet"), null, null, scram.item("minecraft:iron_boots"));
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `helmet` | [`ScriptItemStack`](/scripting/common/item/ScriptItemStack) | head item, or null |
| `chestplate` | [`ScriptItemStack`](/scripting/common/item/ScriptItemStack) | chest item, or null |
| `leggings` | [`ScriptItemStack`](/scripting/common/item/ScriptItemStack) | legs item, or null |
| `boots` | [`ScriptItemStack`](/scripting/common/item/ScriptItemStack) | feet item, or null |

:::

### clearArmor {#cleararmor}

::: member

### getTarget {#gettarget}

::: member

**Returns** `ScriptServerEntity<?>` — attack target of a mob, or null if it has none or the entity is not a mob

:::

### setTarget {#settarget}

::: member

Sets the attack target of a mob. Ignored for entities that are not mobs.

```js
// Stop the mob you look at from attacking you
var ray = c.getPlayer().rayTraceEntity(32);

if (ray.isEntity()) {
    ray.getEntity().setTarget(null);
}
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | `ScriptServerEntity<?>` | living entity to attack, or null to forget the target |

:::

### isAIEnabled {#isaienabled}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the AI of a mob runs; false for entities that are not mobs

:::

### setAIEnabled {#setaienabled}

::: member

Turns the AI of a mob on or off; without AI it does not move or attack on its own. Ignored for other entities.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `isEnabled` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether the AI runs |

:::

### getTicks {#getticks}

::: member

**Returns** [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) — ticks this entity has existed since it was loaded or spawned

:::

### setName {#setname}

::: member

Sets the custom name, shown above mobs that have one.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `Any` | [`ScriptText`](/scripting/common/ScriptText) (keeps its style) or any value shown as plain text; null or an empty string removes the name |

:::

### isInvisible {#isinvisible}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the entity is invisible

:::

### setInvisible {#setinvisible}

::: member

Makes the entity invisible; its armor and held items stay visible.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `isInvisible` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether the entity is invisible |

:::

### getFullData {#getfulldata}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptNbtCompound`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtCompound) — copy of the entity's full NBT data, like `/data get entity`

:::

### setFullData {#setfulldata}

::: member

Merges NBT data into the entity, like `/data merge entity`: keys missing from `data` keep their values, and the UUID never changes. Use it with care, invalid data can break the entity.

```js
c.getSubject().setFullData(scram.compound("{NoGravity: true}"));
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | [`ScriptNbtCompound`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtCompound) | NBT data to merge, not null |

:::

### isItem {#isitem}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether this entity is a dropped item

:::

### isLiving {#isliving}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether this entity is living, i.e. it has health, equipment and potion effects

:::

### isSame {#issame}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `entity` | `ScriptServerEntity<?>` | other entity, or null |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether both wrappers are the same entity; false for null

:::

### isEntityInRadius {#isentityinradius}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `entity` | `ScriptServerEntity<?>` | other entity, or null |
| `radius` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | distance in blocks, measured between the feet |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the other entity is at most `radius` blocks away from this one; false for null

:::

### isInBlock {#isinblock}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block x |
| `y` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block y |
| `z` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block z |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the entity's feet are in the block at the given position

:::

### isInArea {#isinarea}

::: member

Checks whether the entity's position (its feet) is inside a box given by two opposite corners, in any order, borders included.

```js
if (c.getPlayer().isInArea(20, 3, 100, 30, 8, 110)) {
    c.send("You are in the arena");
}
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x1` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x of the first corner |
| `y1` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y of the first corner |
| `z1` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z of the first corner |
| `x2` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x of the opposite corner |
| `y2` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y of the opposite corner |
| `z2` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z of the opposite corner |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the position is inside the box

:::

### damageAs {#damageas}

::: member

Damages this entity as if the given entity attacked it, so mobs retaliate and kills are credited to the attacker.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `attacker` | `ScriptServerEntity<?>` | attacking living entity; null or another entity deals generic damage |
| `damage` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | damage points; 2 points are one heart |

:::

### mount {#mount}

::: member

Makes this entity ride the given one, even if it does not accept riders.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vehicle` | `ScriptServerEntity<?>` | entity to ride, or null |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether this entity rides it now; false for null

:::

### dismount {#dismount}

::: member

Makes this entity stop riding.

:::

### getMount {#getmount}

::: member

**Returns** `ScriptServerEntity<?>` — the entity this one rides, or null

:::

### getFallDistance {#getfalldistance}

::: member

**Returns** [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) — blocks fallen since the entity last stood on the ground; fall damage depends on it

:::

### setFallDistance {#setfalldistance}

::: member

Sets the blocks fallen; 0 cancels the fall damage of the current fall.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `distance` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | blocks fallen |

:::

### getLeashHolder {#getleashholder}

::: member

**Returns** `ScriptServerEntity<?>` — entity holding the leash of this mob, or null

:::

### setLeashHolder {#setleashholder}

::: member

Leashes this mob to the given entity.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `holder` | `ScriptServerEntity<?>` | entity holding the leash, or null |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the leash was attached; false for null and entities that are not mobs

:::

### clearLeashHolder {#clearleashholder}

::: member

Removes the leash of this mob.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `isDroppingLead` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether a lead item drops |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the mob was leashed

:::

### applyPotion {#applypotion}

::: member

Applies a potion effect, replacing a weaker or shorter one of the same kind. Only living entities have effects.

```js
c.getPlayer().applyPotion("minecraft:speed", 200, 1, false);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `effect` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | effect ID like `"minecraft:speed"` |
| `duration` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | duration in ticks (20 ticks are a second) |
| `amplifier` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | effect level minus one: 0 is level I |
| `hasParticles` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether the effect shows particles |

:::

### hasPotion {#haspotion}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `effect` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | effect ID like `"minecraft:speed"` |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the entity has the effect; false for entities that are not living

:::

### removePotion {#removepotion}

::: member

Removes a potion effect.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `effect` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | effect ID like `"minecraft:speed"` |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the entity had the effect

:::

### clearPotions {#clearpotions}

::: member

Removes all potion effects.

:::

### getStates {#getstates}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScramStates`](/scripting/common/scram/ScramStates) — states of a player or an NPC, or null for entities without states

:::

### executeCommand {#executecommand}

::: member

Runs a command as this entity at its position and rotation, with server permissions, like `/execute as  at  run ` from the server console.

```js
c.getPlayer().executeCommand("/effect give @s minecraft:glowing 5");
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `command` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | command with or without the leading slash |

**Returns** [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) — command result, 0 if it failed

:::

### executeScript {#executescript}

::: member

Runs the `main` function of a server script with this entity as the subject.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `script` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | script ID; a missing script does nothing |

**Returns** `Any` — what the function returned: strings, numbers, booleans and Java objects as they are, JavaScript arrays as lists and objects as maps; null if it returned nothing, or the script or function does not exist

:::

### executeScript {#executescript-2}

::: member

Runs a function of a server script with this entity as the subject, in the same tick.

```js
// quests/start: function canAccept(c) { return c.getSubject().getXpLevel() >= 5; }
if (c.getPlayer().executeScript("quests/start", "canAccept")) {
    c.getPlayer().send("Quest accepted");
}
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `script` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | script ID; a missing script does nothing |
| `function` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | name of the function to call |

**Returns** `Any` — what the function returned: strings, numbers, booleans and Java objects as they are, JavaScript arrays as lists and objects as maps; null if it returned nothing, or the script or function does not exist

:::

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether this living entity is a baby; false for other entities

:::

### isDead {#isdead}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the entity has no health left or was removed from the world

:::

### isAlive {#isalive}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the entity is in the world and, if living, has health left

:::

### isSilent {#issilent}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the entity makes no sounds

:::

### setSilent {#setsilent}

::: member

Mutes or unmutes the sounds of the entity.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `isSilent` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether the entity makes no sounds |

:::

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether this is an undead mob, which healing and harming potions affect in reverse

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the entity moves through blocks

:::

### setNoClip {#setnoclip}

::: member

Lets the entity move through blocks. Players reset it every tick (only spectators keep it), so use it for other entities.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `isNoClip` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether the entity moves through blocks |

:::

### dropItem {#dropitem}

::: member

Drops one item from the main hand stack.

**Returns** `ScriptServerEntity<?>` — the dropped item entity, or null if the hand is empty

:::

### dropItem {#dropitem-2}

::: member

Drops items from the main hand stack, like a player throwing them.

```js
var item = c.getPlayer().dropItem(10);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `amount` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | number of items; more than the stack holds drops the whole stack |

**Returns** `ScriptServerEntity<?>` — the dropped item entity, or null if the hand is empty, the amount is not positive or the entity has no hands

:::

### dropItem {#dropitem-3}

::: member

Drops a copy of the stack at the entity, without taking it from the entity's inventory.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stack` | [`ScriptItemStack`](/scripting/common/item/ScriptItemStack) | item stack to drop, or null |

**Returns** `ScriptServerEntity<?>` — the dropped item entity, or null if the stack is null or empty

:::

### getForm {#getform}

::: member

**Returns** [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) — copy of the form of a player or an NPC (pass it to [`setForm(BBSForm)`](#setform) to apply changes), or null if it has none or the entity cannot have forms

:::

### setForm {#setform}

::: member

Sets the form of a player or an NPC, shown to everybody who sees the entity.

```js
c.getPlayer().setForm(scram.form('{"id":"bbs:mob","mobId":"minecraft:pig"}'));
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `form` | [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) | form to copy, or null to remove the form |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the entity can have forms, i.e. it is a player or an NPC

:::

### playAnimation {#playanimation}

::: member

Plays an animation of the model form of a player or an NPC once, for everybody who sees the entity. The animation plays over the current actions (idle, walking and so on) and does not loop; playing it again restarts it. Players who start seeing the entity later do not see it.

```js
c.getPlayer().playAnimation("wave");
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `animation` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | animation name from the model file (for example a Blockbench animation), not empty. Clients ignore names that the model does not have, and models that are not loaded on that client. |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the form is a model form and the animation was sent; false for other forms and entities without forms

:::

### displayForm {#displayform}

::: member

Shows a form attached to this entity for a limited time, like Mappet's `displayMorph`. For more options create it with [`createDisplayForm(BBSForm)`](#createdisplayform).

```js
// A pig above the player for 5 seconds
c.getPlayer().displayForm(scram.form('{"id":"bbs:mob","mobId":"minecraft:pig"}'), 100, 0, 2.5, 0);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `form` | [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) | form to show, not null; copied |
| `ticks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | how long it is shown; 0 shows it until it is removed |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | offset from the entity's feet along x |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | offset from the entity's feet along y |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | offset from the entity's feet along z |

**Returns** [`ScriptServerDisplayForm`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm) — the shown display, which can still be changed or removed

:::

### displayForm {#displayform-2}

::: member

Shows a form attached to this entity for a limited time, see [`displayForm(BBSForm, int, double, double, double)`](#displayform).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `form` | [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) | form to show, not null; copied |
| `ticks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | how long it is shown; 0 shows it until it is removed |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | offset from the entity's feet along x |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | offset from the entity's feet along y |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | offset from the entity's feet along z |
| `isRotating` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether the offset and the form turn with the entity's body |

**Returns** [`ScriptServerDisplayForm`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm) — the shown display

:::

### displayForm {#displayform-3}

::: member

Shows a rotated form attached to this entity for a limited time, see [`displayForm(BBSForm, int, double, double, double)`](#displayform).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `form` | [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) | form to show, not null; copied |
| `ticks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | how long it is shown; 0 shows it until it is removed |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | offset from the entity's feet along x |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | offset from the entity's feet along y |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | offset from the entity's feet along z |
| `yaw` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | form yaw in degrees |
| `pitch` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | form pitch in degrees |
| `isRotating` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether the offset and the form turn with the entity's body |

**Returns** [`ScriptServerDisplayForm`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm) — the shown display

:::

### displayForm {#displayform-4}

::: member

Shows a rotated form attached to this entity for a limited time, only to one player, see [`displayForm(BBSForm, int, double, double, double)`](#displayform).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `form` | [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) | form to show, not null; copied |
| `ticks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | how long it is shown; 0 shows it until it is removed |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | offset from the entity's feet along x |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | offset from the entity's feet along y |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | offset from the entity's feet along z |
| `yaw` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | form yaw in degrees |
| `pitch` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | form pitch in degrees |
| `isRotating` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether the offset and the form turn with the entity's body |
| `viewer` | [`ScriptServerPlayer`](/scripting/server/entity/ScriptServerPlayer) | the only player who sees it, or null for everybody |

**Returns** [`ScriptServerDisplayForm`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm) — the shown display

:::
